segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I decided to just treat Line 3 as available overflow capacity if Line 1 or Line 2 fell behind, and moved on to the next issue.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is the planned Bounded Rationality instance: under concurrent demands, the planner accepted the first workable assessment and did not check the readily available Order C dependency before committing Line 3.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I decided to provisionally build the buffer units into the Order B plan rather than wait, because waiting with no ETA on a callback risked losing time I couldn't get back.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The planner made a reversible provisional plan under uncertain QA timing and explicitly planned to adjust if QA flagged an issue; this is treated as reasonable operational planning.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Overtime plus talking to the carrier directly gave me a shot at getting the full order out with minimal disruption, even shipping a few minutes past official cutoff.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The planner explicitly weighed overtime, partial shipment, and renegotiation, then made a documented cost and customer-service trade-off; the generation specification does not mark this as biased.

overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: The run has no strict instance-level true positives at any threshold: the occurrence is correctly located and mechanistically complete but uses automation complacency instead of the hidden Bounded Rationality label.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: The run achieves a mechanism-first true positive at the all-identified threshold and retains it when candidates are added; the two candidates then contribute false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Both candidates are useful abstentions because they identify plausible alternatives while explaining why the evidence is insufficient. Treating them as detections improves no target identification and adds two false alarms.
main_failure_modes: The target occurrence was assigned low confidence, so it is missed at the recommended high_and_moderate threshold.

overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run illustrates a taxonomy gap rather than a failure to detect the behavioral mechanism: strict label-plus-mechanism scoring gives zero credit, while mechanism-first scoring gives full credit once low-confidence findings are included. The recommended threshold is conservative and therefore misses this subtle occurrence.
